# Anchors — every rectangle a table design may draw into

Canvas is **1280 × 720** (`CANVAS_W`/`CANVAS_H`, `src/ui_theme.h:45-46`). Machine-readable copy:
`anchors.json`. Nothing here comes from a screenshot or a mockup; each row cites the line it was
read from. If a number is not in this file, it is not an anchor yet — go and find its line.

**Picture of all of it: `table-to-scale.png`** (1:1 + legend, regenerated by `./tables/build.sh`).
`anchors.json` is asserted against `src/` on every build — a drifted number fails the build instead of
quietly producing a wrong design.

## What the game paints at rest (not the same as the rect list)

| thing | fill | source |
|---|---|---|
| panel background | `COLOR_PANEL_BG`, black @ alpha **178** | `src/ui_theme.h:38` |
| score strips `255 × 30` | black @ **112** idle, **205** active; the idle one also gets `ui_draw_panel_border` *inside* it | `src/ui_board_status.c:23-28` |
| lanes | black @ 178 + `ui_draw_panel_border` inside each lane | `src/ui_board.c:752-760` |
| combo panels, pause, restart | black @ 178 + border inside | `src/ui_combos.c:44-57`, `src/ui_board.c:1184,1186` |
| the field | **nothing.** `board_get_field_rect()` is a bbox only (`src/ui_board.c:695`) — cards sit straight on the backdrop | |

Gaps: score strip ends y 42, lanes start y 46 (4 px). Lane pitch `37.4 + 4 = 41.4`.

Lane contents: mini cards are `17.324 × 30.652` at `x 54`, step `min(24, (255 − 54 − 17.324)/(n−1))`,
vertically centred (`src/ui_board.c:745, :775`). Far too small for a bezel.

Atlas variants: `assets/atlas.png` and `assets/atlas_deus.png`, both 2112 × 1144, cell
`(cid >> 2) · 176`, `(cid & 3) · 286`; Deus difficulty swaps the texture, not the grid
(`src/ui_board.c:722-723`).

## THE TRAP: two field layouts, only one is live

| | live | dead |
|---|---|---|
| function | `table_slot_rect()` `src/ui_board.c:560-573` | `board_field_slot_xy()` `src/board_layout.c:16-28` |
| step | **81 px**, x = 434 + col\*81 | **96 px**, centred in 430..1080 |
| callers | `board_draw_table()` `src/ui_board.c:1033-1038` | none. Only reachable via `board_get_field_card_rect()` `src/ui_board.c:531`, which also has none |
| result | what you see in game | nothing |

**And the README's own 1:1 table figure is drawn with the dead one.** `tools/make_board_figure.py`
(line 28, `field_slots()`) places the field with `board_field_slot_xy()`, so
`docs/assets/readme/table-map.png` shows field cards 96 px apart where the game draws them 81 px
apart. Anything composited onto that figure looks misaligned even when it is correct — that cost
three rounds on 29 October 2026. The README section *The table, to scale* and its legend inherit
the same error.

**Rule:** never composite onto `table-map.png`. Draw the base yourself from `table_slot_rect()` and
`assets/back.png` + `assets/atlas.png` — see `composite_rules` in `anchors.json`.

## How the field is dealt (so a design can predict where cards appear)

`board_reset_field_slots()`, `src/ui_board.c:575-603`: the opening field is sorted by month
(`board_field_sort_slots()`), split `top = (n+1)/2` / `bottom = n - top`, and centred per row
(`c0 = (8 - top)/2`). 8 cards → columns 2..5 on both rows; 14 → 0..6; 16 → full 2 x 8. Slots are
sticky: a capture frees its slot in place, an unmatched card claims an empty one
(`k_table_slot_order[]`, `src/ui_board.c:553-558`).

Card ids are `(month-1)*4 + slot` (`src/cards.h:20`), so ids `{0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28}` are **eight
different cards**, one per month — not four January cards. Any demo base that uses them is showing
eight weeks of the deck, and it is correct.

## Free space, per panel — the number that decides how heavy a frame can be

| panel group | left | top | right | bottom | heaviest uniform border | what to do instead |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPU block `12,12,255,196` | 12 | 12 | 163 | 300 | **12** | use the right side: asymmetric `(12, 12, 44, 12)` |
| player block `12,508,255,200` | 12 | 300 | 163 | 12 | **12** | same, mirrored |
| right column `1160,12,112,522` | 80 | 12 | 8 | 26 | **8** | asymmetric `(44, 12, 8, 12)` — thick inside, thin at the canvas edge |
| buttons `1160,560,112,90` | 80 | 26 | 8 | 70 | **8** | `(16, 9, 8, 9)` |
| deck `330,262,76,148` | 63 | 54 | 24 | 98 | **24** | `(18, 18, 18, 18)` fits |
| status `480,518,460,34` | — | 84 | — | 14 | **14** | vertical room only; horizontal is the full canvas |

A uniform border is always dragged down by its tightest side. Measure all four before choosing one
number, or the panel comes out thin next to its neighbours for no visible reason.

Seams inside the left blocks: score box ends at y 42, lane B starts at y 46; lane P ends at 669.6,
you-score starts at 678. **8 px rails at y 40 and y 670** split them into separate compartments, and
they must be drawn *after* the block frame or the casing covers them.

## Card rects and why bezels work

| card | size | where |
|---|---|---|
| field | 76 × 124 | `434 + col*81`, rows 170 / 310 |
| hand | 88 × 143 | step 96, centred on 710, y 566 |
| CPU | 56 × 91 | step 62, centred on 710, y 12 |
| choice | 176 × 286 | the two-match prompt |
| mini | 23.324 × 36.652 | inside the capture lanes |

`assets/atlas.png` is 2112 × 1144 = **12 × 4 cells of 176 × 286**, so every card rect is a downscale
of the same cell. A bezel is therefore a per-size PNG drawn at the destination rect, **inside** it
(field slots are 81 px apart for a 76 px card, so a border outside would overlap the neighbour). In
the live code that replaces one `DrawRectangleLinesEx` at `src/ui_board.c:722`. Minis are too small
to carry a bezel.

## Shared draw functions (the chokepoints)

| surface | function | call sites | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| every panel outline in the game | `ui_draw_panel_border()` `src/ui_theme.c:583` | 76 | already frames every panel at its exact rect, inside it |
| every card face | `board_draw_card()` `src/ui_board.c:715` | all modes | 1 px edge line today |
| every card back | `board_draw_card_back()` `src/ui_board.c:728` | all modes | |
| card glow | `board_draw_card_glow()` `src/ui_board.c:737` | all modes | |
| palette | `TerminalTheme g_theme` `src/ui_theme.h:5-14` | everywhere | `theme_set()` cycles 5 |
| panel fill | `COLOR_PANEL_BG` `src/ui_theme.h:38` | everywhere | black @ 178 alpha |
